craft.courtyard.boundaries mode: string
Queues centroid or interpolated implicit material-region boundaries without changing courtyard geometry.
craft.courtyard.cutoff cutoff: float
Queues a -0.15m to 0.15m vertical material-region cutoff without changing courtyard geometry.
craft.courtyard.detail detail: string
Queues coarse, normal, or fine extraction detail for sampling plaques only.
craft.courtyard.inspect angle: string
Views a selected courtyard comparison: front, grazing, arrival, plaster, arcade, carving, or samples.
craft.courtyard.layout width: float doorWidth: float doorOffset: float seed: ulong
Queues courtyard width, doorway width/offset and detail seed regeneration.
craft.courtyard.masonry mode: string
Queues original, regions, or layered construction for the west-wall test section.
craft.courtyard.readout
Reads courtyard generation, geometry and treatment totals.
craft.courtyard.shadows enabled: bool
Queues directional shadow intent for a controlled lighting comparison.
craft.courtyard.study study: string
Queues the stoneworks, reference, or sampling courtyard study for the next product update.
craft.courtyard.treatment treatment: string
Queues balanced, faceted, or soft courtyard regeneration.
craft.courtyard.view x: float y: float z: float targetX: float targetY: float targetZ: float
Moves the ordinary player camera to a selected eye and target for aesthetic comparisons.
